intervalZ.why: z-score of a two-sided 80% interval: an honest observer's range contains the truth four times in five. Wide enough to be useful, narrow enough that a miss happens and is felt.

medium.why: Confidence at or above this reads 'medium'. Below it the interval spans well over half of what the observer would call 'knowing nothing'.

high.why: Confidence at or above this reads 'high': the interval is under a quarter of the know-nothing width.

driver.potential.why: Potential uses the 1..100 attribute scale. An sd of 15 points means the observer cannot tell a midfield driver from a future champion, so confidence is zero there.

potentialSdAtSkill1.why: The weakest scout's first read on potential: an 80% interval about ±15 points wide. Close to guessing, but not quite.

potentialSdAtSkill100.why: The best scout's first read: about ±4 points. Still an estimate — only working with the driver narrows it further (plan 4.1).

ownDriverSdFactor.why: A team reads its own contracted drivers better than rivals do: a season of working together (plan 4.1) cuts the spread of the first estimate to 60%.
